intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Koh Lipe. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Koh Lipe has three main beaches. Pick Pattaya Beach for convenience (ferry drop-off, walking street, lots of dining); Sunrise Beach for a long, clear-water beach that is quieter; Sunset Beach for the quietest spot and sunset views. The island is tiny — you can walk across in about 15 minutes.

faq.q: Which beach should I stay on in Koh Lipe?
faq.a: Pattaya Beach is most convenient — the ferry arrives there and the walking street is full of restaurants. Sunrise Beach is long, clear and quieter, and Sunset Beach is the smallest and quietest. The island is tiny, so all are within walking distance.

faq.q: How do I get to Koh Lipe?
faq.a: Most take a speedboat from Pak Bara pier in Satun province (or connect from Koh Lanta/Phuket in high season). The main season is roughly October–May; off-season seas are rough and boats run less often.

faq.q: Who is Koh Lipe best for?
faq.a: It suits lovers of clear water and pretty beaches, a compact small-island feel, couples and snorkelers — but not those after big-city convenience or heavy nightlife.
